name: Continuous assurance & remediation
purpose: Prepare a monitoring exception and treatment queue for the agreed population and human decision.
telemetry_sources: Reviewed control tests and source evidence
outputs: Linked evidence, ownership and review dependencies
guardrails: Framework applicability must be confirmed for the organization and jurisdiction
Control effectiveness and legal decisions require accountable human review
Public records run locally; production collection requires authorized integration

assessment.acceptance: Complete the domain checks, resolve calculation exceptions, and obtain documented reviewer acceptance. Metadata readiness is not certification or authorization.
